Derived from DB04 CLEAN. Two representations: (A) Facility summary layer — one point per facility with aggregated statistics (mean generation; total disruption days; sedimentation trend; latest status); (B) Annual snapshot — one point per facility per year for temporal mapping. G28 inherits G07 geometry. Step 1: DB04 must be CLEAN. Step 2: Aggregate DB04 by Hydro_ID and period. Step 3: Join to G07 geometry by Hydro_ID. Step 4: QC aggregated values. Step 5: Publish G28 CLEAN.

G28 is the spatial/aggregated representation of DB04. Full time-series remains in DB04. G28 provides facility-level summaries for GIS mapping and is a direct input to G34 criticality index. When DB04 is updated G28 must be regenerated. The aggregation period must be documented. Generation_MWh_Mean and Disruption_Days_Total are the primary analytical attributes.
